This miscellaneous appeal under Section 173 (2) of the Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 has been preferred for enhancement of the award granted in favour of appellants for the death in Motor Vehicle Accident.

2. Case in brief is that mother of appellant Nos.1 to 3 and daughter-in-law of appellant No.4 Raghuveer Rajak and sister-in-law (bhabhi) of appellant No.5 died in an accident dated 02.11.2021 at 4:30 pm when deceased Reshma Rajak was going with Madanmohan Rajak to her house Gram Bhelki to Gram Mau Vyohari, District Shahdol by the Bus No.MP-17-P-1148 driven by respondent No.1 rashly and negligently.
At that time, owner of the Bus was respondent No.2 and Bus was insured by respondent No.3.

3. Under Section 166 of Motor Vehicle Act and compensation of Rs.1,20,00,000/- (Rs. One Crore Twenty Lakh Only) was filed by claiming the age of deceased 32 years and monthly income of Rs.30,000/- per month.
4. Respondent Nos.1 and 2 did not contest the case but respondent No.3 contest the application.

5. Learned Tribunal framed the issues and after recording the evidence, allowed the application partly and total compensation of Rs.14,19,400/- (Rs. Fourteen Lakh Nineteen Thousand Four Hundred Only) was awarded in the heads as below:-

sentences.text:
Challenging the award, this appeal has been preferred for enhancement of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rs.
Two Lakh Only) on the ground that the income of deceased has been assessed on lower side and trial Court overlooked the father-in-law and brother-in-law of the deceased as not to be dependent on the deceased.
Rate of interest has been awarded on the lower side.

7. Heard.
8.
Learned counsel for respondent No.3 has argued that the claimants have been compensated fairly.
No case for enhancement is made out.
Appeal be dismissed.

9. Perused the record.
10.
Tribunal has estimated income of deceased only Rs.7,000/- per month in the last of year 2021.
11. Tribunal has assessed the income of deceased on lower side.

12. Considering the minimum income of unskilled labourer on 02.11.2021 and 40% enhancement for future prospect, the enhancement of Rs.2,00,000/-
(Rs.Two Lakh Only) is just and fair in the head of loss of dependency.
13. This appeal is allowed and compensation of Rs.2,00,000/- (Rs.Two Lakh Only) in the head of loss of dependency is enhanced.
14. Interest @ 6% per annum be also paid on the enhanced compensation to the appellants from the date of application i.e.04.01.2022.
(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE DPS Pranshul Razak vs Ramayan Prasad Tiwari on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133768529/
